findings.detail: Evidence-over-score selection is defensible: MU-H3 has a measured entropy baseline failure and an unseeded named practitioner complaint, while H4 corpus and H1 transcript prevalence are blocked. It is not proof of product value; the ruling correctly makes prevalence the first phase.

The entropy defeat is a 23-sentinel synthetic probe with precision never above 41.7%, not real outbound prevalence. The practitioner issue proves runtime-redaction pain but says nothing about calibration. The ruling mostly states these limits; the project claim must remain unknown-credential wedge, not broad redaction superiority.

Ruling says rung 3 “in full” while Q17 grade retained live-call provenance/calibration and UBS-location standing risks. Q26 discharged provenance at its declared ceiling, but the precise claim should be “rung3 mechanism/proof accepted with disclosed standing risks,” not unconditional security or calibration clearance.
The dated correction explicitly retracts the stale 4–3/7-of-7 claim and records 3/7 plus pane3’s 5-1-1 split. The live ruling does not silently retain the falsified conclusion.

The ruled-out table gives demo-1 retry “none” and demo-8 “none stated.” §3c requires every RULED_OUT to ship an observable retry condition. Add conditions such as a new maintained router surface no longer covering the route, or a safe local-only credential-screen design with a non-leaking boundary; “none” is not a retry predicate.

COD-H3 retry entries “T1 deterministic tooling outside the lane” and “T2 re-file as router with calibration wedge” are directions, not observable predicates. Add a concrete source/tool capability or measured misclassification fixture that reopens the candidate.

No omitted candidate is clearly stronger under the ruling’s evidence-first rule. COD-H4 lacks its corpus, COD-H5 needs the shipped-integrity distinction, and COD-H1 lacks transcript prevalence. MU-H3 is defensible as a first-phase prevalence project, not as a proven winner over their scores.
The ruling records survey ceilings as unverified/conflicted and preserves the local calibration receipt as n=60 rather than converting external agreement into correctness.

required_amendments: Replace demo-1 and demo-8 “none” retry entries with observable predicates.
Make COD-H3 retry conditions measurable predicates.
Qualify COD-H2 “rung3 in full” with the disclosed UBS/provenance standing risks.
